releaseNotes: Journal lists: see which lists each paper's venue is on (FT50, UTD24, AIS Basket, ABDC, CORE, SCImago and more), count your papers by list and tier, and build tenure requirements from the lists, including a points mode. You choose which badges show, in what order, and how many. The concept graph can also read the PDFs attached to a paper's posters (off by default). Cleaner concept graph: abbreviations, academic filler words and place names no longer show up as concepts, and the graph now shows only accepted and published papers; work in progress can be turned on in its options. Automation can tell apart papers with the same title. Adds an automation command that fills in a paper's abstract. Adds a collaboration map that can be a globe or a flat map, with colour themes, a year slider and Play, and a Graph tab that maps the concepts in your papers from their text. Adds a PDF to a poster or talk: attach it in the poster or talk sheet, and a paperclip shows on the poster in the grant's Posters & Talks card. Version 1.7.1 fixed Vitae opening twice after turning on iCloud sync. Version 1.7.0 added iCloud sync between your Macs, a Vitae Plus feature that is off until you turn it on in Settings, Backups. It syncs your library through your private iCloud, with private fields encrypted. Mail, snapshots, preferences and attached files stay on each Mac, and PDFs sync only if you turn on Sync PDFs. Version 1.6.1 added a View on Altmetric link to each paper that has a DOI, PubMed ID or arXiv ID. Version 1.6.0 added posters and talks linked to grants.
